label: Master and subproblem
subgoals: Place the complicating integer variables in the master
Solve the continuous remainder as an LP for the master's choice
Return a feasibility or optimality cut from the subproblem's dual

label: Evaluating an optimality cut
subgoals: Take the dual vector returned by the subproblem
Form the residual h minus G times y at the master's point
Take the inner product as the lower bound on theta

label: Bounds, convergence and fit
subgoals: Take the master optimum as the lower bound
Evaluate the master's choice exactly for the upper bound
Stop when the relative gap meets the tolerance
